bone.label: Cap
witness: He wore a green-and-yellow cap, a bit crooked.
He had a cap on, one of those campaign ones.

panama.label: Panama hat
witness: He had a super fancy Panama hat.
He wore a fine straw hat, Panama style.

capacete.label: Helmet
witness: He didn't take the helmet off even to talk to me.
He kept his helmet on the whole time, even indoors.

peruca.label: Blond wig
witness: He had weird blond hair... I think it was a wig.
His blond bangs were kind of crooked, you know?

cowboy.label: Cowboy hat
witness: He wore a huge rodeo hat with a curled brim.
He had a cowboy hat that barely fit through the door.

jetski.label: Jet ski
witness: He asked where to rent a jet ski.
He said he only rides jet skis these days.

moto.label: Motorcade
witness: He showed up on a loud motorbike, honking.
He said he'd go by motorbike, "in a convoy, like the good old days".

iate.label: Yacht
witness: He mentioned his yacht was anchored nearby.
He asked where to moor a yacht.

patinete.label: Scooter
witness: He left here on an electric scooter.
He rented a scooter through the app.

jatinho.label: Private jet
witness: He said his private jet was waiting at the hangar.
He asked where to land a private jet.

jiujitsu.label: Jiu-jitsu
witness: He kept showing jiu-jitsu moves to the security guard.
He asked if there was a jiu-jitsu gym nearby.

karaoke.label: Karaoke
witness: He sang country ballads at karaoke until the mic begged for mercy.
He asked where there was a karaoke bar open.

golfe.label: Golf
witness: He was carrying a bag of golf clubs.
All he talked about was holes, par and birdies — golf, you know?

selfie.label: Selfie
witness: He took about three hundred selfies in ten minutes.
He was walking around with a giant selfie stick.

churrasco.label: Barbecue
witness: All he talked about was picanha and how done the meat was.
He asked where to buy charcoal and a grill.

leite.label: Bread w/ condensed milk
witness: He ordered a bread roll with condensed milk. Again.
He asked if there was condensed milk to spread on bread.

panetone.label: Panettone
witness: He bought three panettones, even out of season.
His mouth was full of panettone.

chocolate.label: Bonbon
witness: He stuffed his pockets with chocolate bonbons.
He paid with a box of bonbons, can you believe it?

pastel.label: Pastel
witness: He ordered a cheese pastel and sugarcane juice.
His hands were greasy from a fried pastel.

paodequeijo.label: Cheese bread
witness: He ordered a dozen cheese breads to go.
He had cheese-bread crumbs all over his coat.
